description: Set the split-payout percentage for the seller's two payout instruments (Account API v2 updatePayoutPercentage). Pass payoutSplit.payoutInstruments[] with instrumentId (from ebay_get_payout_settings) and a whole-number payoutPercentage; the values must total 100 or eBay rejects the call. Returns success (eBay 204 No Content). Split payouts are only available to mainland China sellers (Payoneer + bank account). Requires the sell.finances scope.

payoutInstruments.description: Split-payout percentage for each ACTIVE payout instrument

payoutPercentage.description: Whole-number percentage 0-100 as a string, e.g. "70"; both instruments must total 100

name: ebay_update_payout_percentage
